1.label: Default
1.detail: The top-right Profile menu checks Default in amber and lists Preview app below it. The sidebar device tile shows a green connection dot and a half-filled battery.

2.label: Additional button 1
2.detail: On the MX Master 4, marker 6 sits on the thumb pad and matches Haptic Sense Panel. Additional button 1 has its own unnumbered row under Outside the diagram.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: The compact mapping list puts Win and Tab keycaps before Task View in a right-aligned pill, opposite Set swipes in Gestures.

4.label: System
4.detail: The Back button editor highlights System in the category column, with Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right and Show desktop beside it. An amber 2 points to the button in the thumb-wheel closeup.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: The empty search dialog keeps the query and clear icon visible and offers Record a keyboard shortcut. The Copy result in the other frame has Ctrl and C keycaps beside Assign.

6.label: Switch pointer speed
6.detail: The wheel editor shows Set up on the pointer speed row. The next panel shows separate amber sliders at 800 and 1600 DPI above Save pointer speed action.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: The short-window dialog keeps the M draft beside Change key. A later frame shows a green check with K saved for Back button, and the restart capture shows K under both Assigned now and Saved shortcut.

8.label: SmartShift
8.detail: The SmartShift tile has an amber radio dot and border. The limited Scroll frame selects Always ratchet and shows only the two toggle rows beneath the wheel modes.

9.label: Tap vs. swipe threshold
9.detail: The slider reads 60 counts above rows with amber directional arrows. The off state replaces the slider with a Saved gesture actions list.

10.label: Pick a window
10.detail: The profile card places Pick a window next to the preview.exe chip. The capture state puts a 4s countdown and Cancel at the right end of an amber banner above the card.

11.label: Pointer speed (DPI)
11.detail: The connected device page shows 1000 above a slider labeled 200 and 4000, next to a separate green battery bar at 50%. The disconnected card uses a crossed-out mouse.

12.label: HID++ features
12.detail: The diagnostics card aligns amber hexadecimal IDs beside names such as SmartShift. Unnamed IDs appear in two rows of chips beneath the list beside Copy IDs.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: A red warning triangle marks the save error above Copy is still unsaved. The amber Try again control sits next to Back to editing under the file-in-use explanation.

14.label: Pause remapping
14.detail: The Windows tray menu swaps Pause remapping for Resume remapping in the same slot, while Start with Windows keeps its checkmark.

1.label: Profile
1.detail: The Default dropdown opens above the button cards with Preview app as another choice.

2.label: Additional button 1
2.detail: On the MX Master 4, this card sits beneath the six numbered controls under Outside the diagram.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: The compact list shows Win and Tab keycaps followed by Task View on the right.

4.label: System
4.detail: The selected category has an amber tinted background and lists Task View and desktop navigation actions.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: A search for zzzz shows a Record a keyboard shortcut button in the empty result area.

6.label: Switch pointer speed
6.detail: Its row says Alternate two DPI values and has a Set up button.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: The reopened Back button editor shows K in a large central panel and Assigned now K above it.

8.label: Flick sensitivity
8.detail: The SmartShift screen shows value 10 above a slider with endpoints 1 and 50.

9.label: Tap vs. swipe threshold
9.detail: The slider shows 60 counts, with swipe action rows beneath it.

10.label: Switch to the window you want to add
10.detail: An amber banner displays a 4s countdown and Cancel button above the profile card.

11.label: Disconnected
11.detail: A wide card pairs a crossed mouse icon with instructions to wake or reconnect the mouse.

12.label: HID++ features
12.detail: Hexadecimal IDs appear beside named features, and unnamed IDs appear as chips below Copy IDs.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: The error says Copy is still unsaved and offers Try again and Back to editing.

14.label: Start with Windows
14.detail: A checkmark appears to the left of this item in both tray menu states.

1.label: Profile
1.detail: The top-right Default menu opens to Default with an amber checkmark and Preview app below it in both themes.

2.label: Outside the diagram
2.detail: The MX Master 4 has six numbered circles on its artwork, followed by an unnumbered Additional button 1 row below the six matching cards.

3.label: Gesture button tap
3.detail: The compact list displays Win and Tab keycaps beside Task View, with Set swipes in Gestures. beneath the button name.

4.label: Tabs & windows
4.detail: The compact picker selects this category in amber and shows Close tab checked, with Ctrl + W aligned at the right of its row.

5.label: No matching actions
5.detail: The zzzz search produces an empty-state message with a Record a keyboard shortcut button, while Copy produces one result with Ctrl and C keycaps and Assign.

6.label: Switch pointer speed
6.detail: The wheel action panel puts Set up beside the two-DPI action and Assign beside Switch wheel mode; the editor displays 800 and 1600 DPI sliders.

7.label: Saved shortcut
7.detail: The ordered frames show recording, an M draft, cancellation, then saving K with a green-check toast; reopened and restarted views show K under Saved shortcut.

8.label: Ignore accidental nudges
8.detail: The full scroll view shows value 4 on an off-to-8 slider beneath Flick sensitivity, with SmartShift selected in amber.

9.label: Tap vs. swipe threshold
9.detail: The enabled view shows 60 counts above five gesture rows; the off view removes the threshold and labels the still-visible rows Saved gesture actions.

10.label: Switch to the window you want to add
10.detail: Window capture displays a wide amber notice with a 4s countdown and Cancel, above the Preview app and Default cards.

11.label: Reapply settings
11.detail: The connected device view pairs Bluetooth and firmware cards, a green 50% battery bar, and a Current DPI card reading 1000.

12.label: HID++ features
12.detail: Named hexadecimal feature IDs form two aligned columns in one card; Unnamed features appear below as small chips beside Copy IDs.

13.label: Couldn't save assignment
13.detail: A red warning triangle precedes the error; Copy is still unsaved. appears above a settings-file explanation and Try again and Back to editing buttons.

14.label: Start with Windows
14.detail: Both native white tray menus check this entry, while Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping in the paused frame.
